contexts.text: They have not reached the days of the years () = not elevated to the state. To reach = to be elevated. Explained.
Ye shall cause to reach to the lintel and the two posts ().
To pursue, or touch, = influx, through which is communication; here, of falsities from evil.
To which human knowledges never reach.
Her sins have reached even to Heaven () = that their evils have closed up Heaven... For, when evils reach to Heaven, they close it.
